feedback_text: Our vaccines were ruined during a 4-hour delay in Arizona because the trailer temperature sensor didn't warn us before the cooling unit failed.
We love the warehouse units but we really need an automated mobile app that alerts freight drivers 30 minutes BEFORE a thermal breach happens.
Unplanned compressor downtime on Assembly Line 4 cost us $450k last month. Why can't your sensors predict motor bearing failure based on heat output?
Your indoor environmental sensor logs are super accurate. We would pay a premium if you provided outdoor urban footfall and microclimate analytics for real estate site selection.
Regulatory compliance requires signed temperature audit certificates for every mile of travel. Manual logging is killing our operational margins.
